speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: To remain relevant, we must continue to tap on a global blend of people and ideas to move Singapore ahead and, in doing so, create more opportunities for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will continue to welcome talent to augment our economic vitality while ensuring that Singaporeans get the necessary education and training to do well in the global economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore must be a place where everyone is treated fairly and have equal opportunities to succeed based on merit and hard work, regardless of background.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will foster greater mutual understanding and appreciation between different people living in Singapore, through facilitating more social interactions and raising awareness of shared societal values and norms.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will promote a pro-family environment where Singaporeans can fulfil their family and work aspirations.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We have strengthened support for marriage and parenthood, for example, through enhanced housing and childcare policies.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Even as we improve these measures, we must recognise the need for broader societal support.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: As more mothers remain active in the workforce, there is room for fathers to play more active roles in bringing up children.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Employers are also critical in ensuring good workplace support.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will partner people-sector organisations which share our family focus to cultivate stronger social support for marriage and parenthood.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singaporeans based overseas are part of our Singapore family.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: While we encourage Singaporeans to gain overseas experience, we will also engage them closely and facilitate their transition back home when they wish to return.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: There are many needs to be fulfilled and we will strive to strike the right balance.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will take an open and consultative approach in our population strategies to ensure that all views are heard.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: This is critical in achieving the balance we strive for.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will work hand-in-hand with Singaporeans to co-create our future together.
